opportunities.title: Immersive Universe Visualization Website
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a visually-driven website that lets visitors journey through galaxies, stars, and black holes as if they were floating in space themselves. The emphasis is on spectacle rather than long blocks of text, so smooth animations, rich imagery, and interactive elements are essential. When a user scrolls or clicks, I want nebulae to unfold, black-hole accretion disks to glow, and stellar nurseries to reveal their depth—something that feels closer to a planetarium show than a traditional educational site. Here’s what I need from you: a fully developed, responsive site that opens with an engaging hero scene, guides the visitor through the cosmic structures mentioned above, and wraps everything in a lightweight UI that never distracts from the view. WebGL, Three.js, or similar frameworks are welcome if they keep performance high across modern browsers and mobile. I will supply copy snippets and a basic color palette; you weave them into the visual flow, handle all coding, and optimise images or shaders so the experience stays smooth. Acceptance criteria • Homepage loads in under 3 seconds on a standard 4G connection • Interactive sequences for galaxies, stars, and black holes function without visible frame drops on desktop and current-gen mobile • All visuals render correctly in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge • Source files, instructions for deployment, and a brief walkthrough video delivered on hand-off If you have a portfolio piece that already showcases space-themed WebGL work or cinematic UI, point me to it—I’d love to see it before we start.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40797900, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: Positive Character STL Design Set
opportunities.description: I’m launching a small, home-based brand that promotes mental-health positivity and I have three original 2D character sketches ready to be brought to life. I need each one converted into a clean, print-ready 3D model (SAL/STL) with medium detail—clear facial features and a few fun accessories, but nothing so fine that it becomes unprintable on a standard hobby FDM or resin printer. Functionality is important: every character should come in two practical versions. First, a keychain or bag-charm edition with an integrated loop that won’t snap after repeated use. Second, a free-standing desk ornament with a stable, flat base. That means six final files in total, each watertight, manifold, correctly oriented, and scaled (roughly 35–40 mm for keychains and 60–70 mm for desk figures—open to your advice here). Deliverables • Three characters in SAL/STL format, each supplied in keychain and desk-stand variants • Source files from the package you model in (Blender, ZBrush, Fusion 360, etc.) • Simple renders for my online store thumbnails • Transfer of full commercial rights on completion If this first set sells well, I’ll be back for more characters and accessories, potentially with articulated or higher-detail versions. Let’s create something that spreads a little positivity every time it’s printed.

opportunities.title: Unity3D Addressable Asset Expert - Quotation Request
opportunities.description: Please provide your estimated total development price in USD and estimated completion time for the historical software-development scenario below. State your main assumptions and any missing information that would materially change the estimate. Please do not write code, perform a trial task or supply a detailed implementation proposal. REFERENCE SCENARIO — historical requirements, not instructions to begin work: Illusion Trails is looking for a Unity Addressable Asset Expert to look at our app, make recommendations, and apply those recommendations into the project. The Illusion Trails app allows the user to select a 3D world from a list of 3D environments, the expert we hire will understand Scene asset bundle loading, dependency management, asset bundle organization, and project organization. We need an expert capable of creating an asset structure compatible with adding future worlds. Four worlds are currently embedded. Those assets need moved into the addressable asset location. Additionally, a 5th world that is not currently in the project needs moved to the same location. In the future, as new worlds are added, we may need to hire you again to add those assets and possible other app related tasks. The attached files illustrate the type of assets in the 5 worlds. The Addressable Asset System allows the developer to ask for an asset via its address. Once an asset (e.g. a prefab) is marked "addressable", it generates an address which can be called from anywhere. Wherever the asset resides (local or remote), the system will locate it and its dependencies, then return it. Addressables use asynchronous loading to support loading from any location with any collection of dependencies. Whether you have been using direct references, traditional asset bundles, or Resource folders, addressables provide a simpler way to make your game more dynamic. Addressables simultaneously opens up the world of asset bundles while managing all the complexity. If you have the skills to accomplish this for us, please apply for this job and list any previous work related to Addressable Asset Bundling. Thank you. Estimating assumptions and context: The scenario is based on a Freelancer listing from 2021-11-27 (historical project ID 32209886). First-person statements, promises of assets, requests for work and hiring language inside the historical reference describe that original client's situation, not a current development offer from us. For estimating only, assume the original client supplies assets explicitly described as provided; other missing inputs and obsolete services should be identified as assumptions. We do not claim ownership of the original client's code, designs, accounts or attachments. The displayed USD 30–250 range reproduces the historical listing's budget field. It is not participation compensation or a binding development offer. Please give your realistic estimate even if outside that range. Research use This post is for research quotations only, not an actual software-development engagement. No development contract will be awarded. Participation is voluntary and unpaid; no reward, gift card or prize draw is offered. Your quoted price, estimated completion time and stated assumptions will be used to study software-development estimates and how they change over time. Thank you for your time and consideration. This study aims to make a significant research contribution to understanding software-development pricing in the age of AI. We appreciate any estimate you choose to share.

opportunities.title: Guarantee AdSense Approval for Directory
opportunities.description: My site groupswa.com is a public directory that curates WhatsApp, Telegram, and Signal group links. Google keeps flagging it for “thin content,” so AdSense is still out of reach. I need an expert who can step in, reshape the site, and deliver a confirmed approval notice. What I know so far • I already review every link before it goes live, but that alone clearly isn’t enough. • The fastest path looks like a full content and policy overhaul rather than scattered tweaks—that’s the approach I want you to lead. Content resources you can count on I can supply or sign off on: 1. Original articles that teach visitors how to join and use groups safely. 2. Expanded, keyword-rich descriptions for every single listing. 3. Fresh policy pages covering rules, privacy, contact, and anything else Google wants to see. Your mission • Audit the entire site against the latest AdSense Program Policies. • Map out a clear content plan (structure, length, internal linking, schema, etc.). • Implement or guide the creation of the new articles, enhanced listings, and mandatory legal pages. • Tidy up technical signals—meta tags, robots.txt, page speed, mobile UX—all the usual AdSense friction points. • Submit for re-review and keep adjusting until the approval email lands in my inbox. Acceptance criteria AdSense approval for groupswa.com within the agreed timeline. No approval, no finish. I’m ready to cooperate on content production and give you backend access as needed. Let’s get this directory fully compliant and finally monetized.

The logo reference is already available, and we will share it with the selected freelancer. The main requirement is to recreate the provided design accurately and prepare the branding materials listed below. No new logo concepts or extensive creative exploration are required. Since the logo reference is already finalized, we believe the project can be completed efficiently without spending time on multiple logo concepts. Please share: * Your best price for the complete scope * Your estimated delivery time * Your portfolio or relevant samples We regularly work on client projects and would be glad to build a long-term working relationship with the right freelancer. If you are interested, please send your proposal. We look forward to working together.

opportunities.title: One simple 3D spaceship equipment module for Godot game
opportunities.description: I am developing Imperio Minero, an independent space-mining game in Godot. I am looking for an artist to make ONE simple, original 3D equipment module that can be attached to an existing spaceship hardpoint. The first piece could be a compact mining laser, scanner or engine housing. This is a small pilot task, not a request for a complete spaceship or a large asset pack. I will provide screenshots of the ship, approximate dimensions and the mounting position before work begins. The piece should be suitable for a game and visually consistent with a grounded industrial sci-fi style. Please deliver an editable Blender file and an exported GLB (or FBX suitable for conversion), with simple materials or textures. Please confirm that commercial use in the game is included and that you have the rights to all elements used. opportunities.title: Tour Package Showcase Website
opportunities.description: I need a clean, modern website that lets travelers explore my local tour packages in detail and reach out easily when they are ready to book. The site’s core purpose is browsing, not online payment, so every page should guide visitors toward a simple enquiry or contact form. Each package page must display price, trip duration, a day-by-day itinerary, an image gallery, hotel details, and space for customer reviews. Because my focus is strictly domestic destinations, the layout and visuals should celebrate the diversity of sights within our country rather than generic stock shots of far-off places. I’m comfortable with WordPress or any other user-friendly CMS that will let me add new tours, update prices, and moderate reviews without touching code. Fast loading times, mobile responsiveness, and basic on-page SEO are essential so travelers can find us and enjoy the experience on any device. Deliverables • Fully functional, mobile-responsive website installed on my hosting • Custom tour package template with editable fields for price, duration, itinerary, photos, hotel details, and reviews • Contact form routed to my email and/or WhatsApp • Written hand-off guide or short video showing how to add or edit tours, upload photos, and approve reviews Once the design is live and I’ve tested adding a few tours myself, the project will be complete. If you’ve built similar travel or hospitality sites, please share links so I can see your style.

opportunities.title: Character Artist Needed for 3D Shooter Game (Mini Militia Style)
opportunities.description: We are developing an indie 3D side-view action/shooter game (stylistically comparable to Mini Militia, featuring fast-paced tactical movement, weapons, and side-scrolling mechanics rendered with 3D models). We are looking for an experienced and talented 3D Character Artist to design, model, texture, and rig a set of characters and basic variants for our gameplay pipeline. Scope of Work: 1. Character Modeling: Create low-poly to mid-poly stylized 3D character models optimized for real-time game engines. The models must be clean, with proper topology suited for skeletal deformation and animation. Character should have these variations features:- 1. Three kind of head shape thin, medium, and fat head. 2. Body should also have 3 kind along with female. 3. Leg and hand 3 kind. 4. Different kind of ear (also include elf type) 5. Different kind of hair with skeletal/bone for jiggle in the game. 6. Different kind of eyebrow textures. 7. Three different nose type small medium, and big. 8. Lips variations. 9. All above mentioned kind must have female version. 10. Texturing/Shading: Provide clean, hand-painted or stylized PBR textures (or stylized materials) that fit a vibrant, military-cartoon aesthetic. 11. Rigging & Skinning: Rig the characters with a standard humanoid skeletal structure ready for game engine import (compatible with Godot/Unity/Unreal pipelines). 12. Variations: Create customizable or modular equipment slots (e.g., helmets, weapon holding pose etc. 13. A small animation set—idle, run, jump, shoot, melee, and death—loop-ready and consistent in timing.

opportunities.title: Create and upload a webview app for iOS - Quotation Request -- 2
opportunities.description: Please provide your estimated total development price in USD and estimated completion time for the historical software-development scenario below. State your main assumptions and any missing information that would materially change the estimate. Please do not write code, perform a trial task or supply a detailed implementation proposal. REFERENCE SCENARIO — historical requirements, not instructions to begin work: I need to compile the URL of a mobile site that is already done, to create a webview app for iOS and upload the app to the AppStore. AS TO THE CREATION: - It is necessary that the iOS app has all the features of the website and the webview android app working correctly. - It is possible to check the website at newscale.app (mobile version) and the webview android app can be checked through the APK that is attached. - It is necessary that the app is compatible with at least iOS 10 until the latest version available on the project start date. - I will provide the icon art and any other necessary design elements. In addition to the basic settings for a webview, you also need to develop the following: 1. Splash screen (Art will be provided - e.g. img1). 2. When the user is not connected to the internet, it should show a standard screen, with the option to try again (Art will be provided - e.g. img2). 3. When opening a news link, it should show a header at the top with the option "back to newscale" which should go back to the same screen it was before opening the news (The art will be provided - e.g. img3). 4. Allow to upload the user's profile image. 5. When the user shares a news on whatsapp, twitter, messenger or facebook he must open the share directly in these apps and, failing that, through the browser. 6. Define the scheme as newscaleapp. 7. Identify when the url starts with newscaleapp and change that part to https. AS FOR THE PUBLICATION: - I have an Apple developer account and I will give you temporary access to upload. - I just need you to upload the app, because I don't have a mac, but all the prints, descriptions, categorization, etc ... will be done by myself. ---------------------------------------------------------- Payment will be released 2 days after publication in the AppStore. That way I will be able to download and test the app. Estimating assumptions and context: The scenario is based on a Freelancer listing from 2021-05-07 (historical project ID 30125443). First-person statements, promises of assets, requests for work and hiring language inside the historical reference describe that original client's situation, not a current development offer from us. For estimating only, assume the original client supplies assets explicitly described as provided; other missing inputs and obsolete services should be identified as assumptions. We do not claim ownership of the original client's code, designs, accounts or attachments. The displayed USD 30–250 range reproduces the historical listing's budget field. It is not participation compensation or a binding development offer. Please give your realistic estimate even if outside that range. Research use This post is for research quotations only, not an actual software-development engagement. No development contract will be awarded. Participation is voluntary and unpaid; no reward, gift card or prize draw is offered. Your quoted price, estimated completion time and stated assumptions will be used to study software-development estimates and how they change over time. Thank you for your time and consideration. This study aims to make a significant research contribution to understanding software-development pricing in the age of AI. We appreciate any estimate you choose to share.

opportunities.title: An e-commerce website + Mobile App (iPhone + Android) for sell the perishable product - Quotation Request
opportunities.description: Please provide your estimated total development price in INR and estimated completion time for the historical software-development scenario below. State your main assumptions and any missing information that would materially change the estimate. Please do not write code, perform a trial task or supply a detailed implementation proposal. REFERENCE SCENARIO — historical requirements, not instructions to begin work: Hi Everyone, We are expanding our business and planning to take a step forward in Digital online marketing. We are looking for a professional team to make this happens. We want to create an e-commerce website with following requirements and business model. 1) About our product- We sell perishable item and want to make it online for everyone. At this moment, there is one single model entity which we would like to make it online, hence website & logic will not be too complex. It’s simple static website with payment gateway. Our aim – “anyone can order our product from anywhere”. 2) As I said- we want to make our website as e-commerce where user can add our product in bucket and make the appropriate payment accordingly. How would you handle this functionality & payment gateway ? 3) The website will have few pages only. Like Home, Menu, Order Now, Contact us. How would you handle contact / feedback / review pages ? Wil you integrate sms functionality as well? So that we will get notification immediately ? 4) Online Promotion. Facebook, Instagram page & links to the website. + WhatsApp enables on each page 5) Once user can place the order & make the payment. How will you handle the tracking functionality of the orders ? 6) How will you integrate logistics functionality on the website ? so that we (either us or user) can track the orders ? 7) Maintenance window - Once you developed the website, will there any maintenance window (Monthly or quarterly) where we can reach out to you for any minor changes ? 8) In this project, will users (visitor) require creating an account for placing any orders ? 9) Once user placed the orders, can we enable live tracking system of the product in our website where user can track the orders itself? 10) Which technology (platform, programming language) would you prefer to cover all above requirements ? 11) Most important- Please mention about data security part in terms of customer data + orders information + payment. Please note- We have already purchased web hosting (Windows) and domain from Go-Daddy. So, team can use cPanel to develop this website. If you are reading this line, hope you have gone through all above requirements. Now I want you to come up with normal 2-3 ppt slide that how you are planning to develop a solution for us. Please drop a note on my email ID with your ppt attachment & proposals. Estimating assumptions and context: The scenario is based on a Freelancer listing from 2022-01-10 (historical project ID 32600186). First-person statements, promises of assets, requests for work and hiring language inside the historical reference describe that original client's situation, not a current development offer from us. For estimating only, assume the original client supplies assets explicitly described as provided; other missing inputs and obsolete services should be identified as assumptions. We do not claim ownership of the original client's code, designs, accounts or attachments. The displayed INR 12500–37500 range reproduces the historical listing's budget field. It is not participation compensation or a binding development offer. Please give your realistic estimate even if outside that range. Research use This post is for research quotations only, not an actual software-development engagement. No development contract will be awarded. Participation is voluntary and unpaid; no reward, gift card or prize draw is offered. Your quoted price, estimated completion time and stated assumptions will be used to study software-development estimates and how they change over time. Thank you for your time and consideration. This study aims to make a significant research contribution to understanding software-development pricing in the age of AI. We appreciate any estimate you choose to share.

opportunities.title: Product Development Engineer Needed – Consumer Electronics Prototype -- 2
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer or Product Development Engineer to help develop a new portable consumer electronic product from concept to prototype. The project requires a combination of mechanical engineering, product design and basic electrical engineering knowledge. Initial Scope of Work: 1- Evaluate the technical feasibility of the concept. 2- Define the main mechanical and functional requirements. 3- Develop the initial mechanical design and internal component layout. 4- Prepare preliminary 3D CAD models. 5- Identify suitable materials and components. 6- Provide recommendations for prototyping and manufacturing. 7- Prepare technical documentation and an initial Bill of Materials (BOM). Ideal Candidate Proven experience in mechanical product development. Experience designing physical consumer products. Knowledge of mechanical assemblies and moving mechanisms. Experience with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or Creo. Familiarity with electronic product integration. Experience taking concepts through prototyping and testing. Important This is an original product concept. Further technical details, specifications and design information will be shared with shortlisted candidates after signing a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). Please include examples of previously developed physical products and briefly describe your role in those projects. The initial engagement will focus on technical feasibility and concept development. Further development and prototyping may follow based on the results of the first phase.

opportunities.title: Chat app using React-Native - Quotation Request
opportunities.description: Please provide your estimated total development price in USD and estimated completion time for the historical software-development scenario below. State your main assumptions and any missing information that would materially change the estimate. Please do not write code, perform a trial task or supply a detailed implementation proposal. REFERENCE SCENARIO — historical requirements, not instructions to begin work: A chatting app built with React Native, Socket.io and React Navigation. No backend, just frontend. As simple as possible. iOS versions: 12+ Android versions: 7.0+ SCREEN - main screen (messages) - search screen (for messages) - contacts list screen - chat screen - archived messages screen - settings screen - login screen - forgot password screen DESCRIPTION The user must login by establishing a session with a REST API, accessing a message screen similar to WhatsApp. The session will maintain communication via websocket. The websocket server and REST API server must be simulated (no backend necessary) Websocket: - Send and receive messages - Send and receive read and receive confirms - Server notifications - Contacts profile updates - Block/unblock contact REST API: - Establish the login session - Send a password recovery request - Update user profile information - Send contacts list to the server The conversation must support displaying and sending text, image, audio, and location messages. It should be possible to record the audio to send, just like in WhatsApp. It should be possible to take a photo or send an image file, just like on WhatsApp. It should be possible to send the current GPS coordinates as a message. In the conversation, it should be possible to see the contact information (profile), similar to WhatsApp. Profile must have "save contact" button to add profile information to device contacts. The profile must have the option to "block/unblock" the contact. The profile should present the option of "notifications" with the options "default", "always notify" and "never notify" (mirrored in the settings). The profile must have the option "archive the conversation", which can be automatically unarchived when receiving a new message, as per the option selected in the settings (similar to WhatsApp). The main screen should have a search option for words present in messages, similar to WhatsApp. The main screen must be able to have messages pinned. On the main screen, when holding the message, icons should appear, similar to WhatsApp, with options to “archive message”, “pin message” and “delete message” (with prior confirmation). The contacts screen should list all contacts that have already received a message. It should also list device contacts if the contact was manually loaded through settings. When touching the contact, the message screen should open. When holding the contact, you must access the user's information (profile, similar to conversation). The settings screen should be divided into: - "Profile": It should be possible to change name and description (similar to WhatsApp), sending the update via REST API; - "Contacts": It must be possible to "load contacts from device contact list", which must load contacts and associate with already existing contacts that use the same phone number and send this to the server (REST API). And it should be possible to "remove contacts without message history", which should display a message confirming the action and, if confirmed, delete all contacts without message history (send this action via REST API). Holding the contact, it should be possible to remove the contact, asking for confirmation if there is message history (send this action via REST API). - "Notifications": Must be an option to enable/disable all message notifications. There should be an "always notify" contact list and a "never notify" contact list. There should be a list of "Blocked Contacts". - "Conversations": It should be an option similar to the "archived messages" function of WhatsApp, and an option to "Clear messages older than X days" which, when triggered, displays a message confirming the action and, if confirmed, deletes all messages older than X days. Estimating assumptions and context: The scenario is based on a Freelancer listing from 2022-09-13 (historical project ID 34638282). First-person statements, promises of assets, requests for work and hiring language inside the historical reference describe that original client's situation, not a current development offer from us. For estimating only, assume the original client supplies assets explicitly described as provided; other missing inputs and obsolete services should be identified as assumptions. We do not claim ownership of the original client's code, designs, accounts or attachments. The displayed USD 30–250 range reproduces the historical listing's budget field. It is not participation compensation or a binding development offer. Please give your realistic estimate even if outside that range. Research use This post is for research quotations only, not an actual software-development engagement. No development contract will be awarded. Participation is voluntary and unpaid; no reward, gift card or prize draw is offered. Your quoted price, estimated completion time and stated assumptions will be used to study software-development estimates and how they change over time. Thank you for your time and consideration. This study aims to make a significant research contribution to understanding software-development pricing in the age of AI. We appreciate any estimate you choose to share.

opportunities.title: Build Collaborative Grok AI Organization
opportunities.description: Grok AI Developer & Consultant | Multi-Agent AI System | Live Teams Collaboration Project Type: Ongoing, hourly Budget: $40–$75/hour, depending on experience Initial Engagement: 2-hour paid working session Experience Level: Expert Project Overview I'm a business owner looking for an experienced xAI Grok developer to work directly with me in building a personal and business AI organization. I want to begin by creating and configuring bots within Grok, then eventually develop a private dashboard accessible from my computer and phone. I'm looking for a collaborative developer who enjoys teaching and building alongside clients through live screen-sharing sessions, preferably using Microsoft Teams where permitted by the hiring platform. Phase 1: Personal AI Assistant Create a personal assistant that can help manage everyday activities, information, scheduling, reminders, research, and tasks. Phase 2: AI Chief Operating Officer Develop an AI COO that can coordinate business activities, assign work to specialized bots, monitor progress, review reports, and escalate issues. Phase 3: Specialized AI Agents Build agents responsible for: Financial analysis using Excel, PDFs, and invoices Operational reporting and KPI monitoring Quality assurance and compliance reviews Employee productivity and performance reporting Business process automation The goal is to enable communication and task delegation between agents, with centralized reporting through the AI COO. Phase 4: Private Dashboard Eventually develop a secure web-based dashboard that allows me to interact with the AI organization from my phone and computer. Required Qualifications Hands-on experience with Grok Bot and xAI APIs Experience designing multi-agent AI systems Python, API integrations, and workflow automation Excel, PDF, and Microsoft 365 integrations Ability to explain technical concepts to a non-developer Availability for recurring live working sessions Experience designing secure systems with appropriate access controls Application Requirements Please provide: Examples of Grok bots or multi-agent systems you have personally built. Whether you have implemented communication and task delegation between AI agents. Your experience with Grok's native bot functionality versus custom API development. Your hourly rate and availability during US Central Time business hours. Confirmation that you are comfortable teaching and building collaboratively during live sessions. Important: I'm not looking for a developer who simply delivers a completed project. I want someone who will build this with me, explain each step, and help me become comfortable managing and expanding the system independently.

opportunities.title: Product Development Engineer Needed – Consumer Electronics Prototype
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer or Product Development Engineer to help develop a new portable consumer electronic product from concept to prototype. The project requires a combination of mechanical engineering, product design and basic electrical engineering knowledge. Initial Scope of Work: 1- Evaluate the technical feasibility of the concept. 2- Define the main mechanical and functional requirements. 3- Develop the initial mechanical design and internal component layout. 4- Prepare preliminary 3D CAD models. 5- Identify suitable materials and components. 6- Provide recommendations for prototyping and manufacturing. 7- Prepare technical documentation and an initial Bill of Materials (BOM). Ideal Candidate Proven experience in mechanical product development. Experience designing physical consumer products. Knowledge of mechanical assemblies and moving mechanisms. Experience with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or Creo. Familiarity with electronic product integration. Experience taking concepts through prototyping and testing. Important This is an original product concept. Further technical details, specifications and design information will be shared with shortlisted candidates after signing a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). Please include examples of previously developed physical products and briefly describe your role in those projects. The initial engagement will focus on technical feasibility and concept development. Further development and prototyping may follow based on the results of the first phase.

opportunities.title: Complete Business Branding, Website, Social Media & Digital Marketing Setup for Caffine Tech – A to Z**
opportunities.description: ## ABOUT OUR BUSINESS We are two business partners launching a commercial coffee equipment sourcing and export business called **CAFFINE TECH**, based in Melbourne, Australia\. Our business will focus on sourcing commercial coffee machines, espresso machines, coffee grinders and related equipment from Australia and supplying international wholesale buyers, distributors, importers and commercial customers\. We want to establish a professional international business presence from scratch\. We are looking for a talented freelancer who can handle the complete setup, including logo design, branding, website development, social media accounts, content creation, business profiles and all related digital assets\. We have some initial logo ideas and concepts generated with ChatGPT\. We will share these ideas and references\. You must create a professional final logo based on our direction\. ## 1\. LOGO DESIGN & COMPLETE BRAND IDENTITY - Create a unique and professional business logo\. - Use our ideas and references as the starting point\. - Develop a premium, modern and internationally recognisable brand identity\. - Select professional brand colours and fonts\. - Create different logo versions (full logo, icon, horizontal and vertical)\. - Provide transparent PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF files\. - Provide original editable/source files\. - Create a brand guidelines document\. - Design business cards\. - Design email signature\. - Create letterhead and invoice templates\. - Create social media profile and cover designs\. ## 2\. COMPLETE SOCIAL MEDIA SETUP Create and configure all business accounts: - Instagram Business Account - Facebook Business Page - Meta Business Suite - LinkedIn Company Page - TikTok Business Account - YouTube Business Channel - Pinterest Business Account (if suitable) For every platform: - Professional profile setup\. - Business description and bio\. - Profile picture and cover/banner\. - Website and contact information\. - Consistent brand identity\. - Relevant business categories\. - Proper account settings\. - Connect platforms where possible\. ## 3\. PROFESSIONAL WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT Build a modern, professional, mobile\-friendly and responsive website\. Use a FREE website builder and FREE hosting/subdomain\. We do not want to purchase a domain or hosting at this stage\. Website pages: 1. Home 2. About Us 3. Our Products 4. Commercial Espresso Machines 5. Commercial Coffee Grinders 6. Our Services 7. Australian Equipment Sourcing 8. International Export 9. Wholesale & B2B Enquiries 10. Contact Us Website features: - Professional homepage design\. - Product images and product categories\. - Product enquiry forms\. - Contact form\. - WhatsApp contact button\. - Email contact button\. - Social media links\. - Mobile\-friendly design\. - Basic SEO\. - Google indexing setup\. - Basic website analytics\. - Privacy Policy and Terms pages using appropriate templates\. - Easy\-to\-use website dashboard so we can update everything ourselves\. ## 4\. BUSINESS EMAIL & CONTACT SETUP - Set up a professional business email solution using a free option where available\. - Create email signature\. - Configure contact details on website\. - Set up WhatsApp Business profile\. - Add business description, logo and catalogue where available\. - Create professional enquiry response templates\. No paid email subscription or domain purchase without our approval\. ## 5\. SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATION Create an initial professional content library\. Required: - 15 Instagram/Facebook posts\. - 10 LinkedIn posts\. - 5 promotional banners\. - 5 Instagram Reels or short promotional videos\. - 5 TikTok short videos adapted from the content\. - Captions and hashtags\. - Product introduction templates\. - Educational posts about commercial coffee equipment\. - Australian sourcing and export\-related posts\. - Wholesale buyer promotional content\. All content must use consistent branding and professional visuals\. Do not use misleading product availability, fake customer reviews or unverified business claims\. ## 6\. PRODUCT CATALOGUE & BUSINESS PRESENTATION Create: - Professional PDF company profile\. - Digital product catalogue template\. - Commercial coffee machine product templates\. - Coffee grinder product templates\. - Wholesale enquiry brochure\. - Business introduction presentation\. - Editable quotation template\. - Editable invoice template\. The documents should be designed so we can add our actual products, specifications, prices and photographs later\. ## 7\. GOOGLE & ONLINE BUSINESS PRESENCE Set up where eligible: - Google Business Profile\. - Google Search Console\. - Google Analytics\. - Basic website SEO\. - Website sitemap\. - Google indexing\. - Social media sharing links\. - Business contact information consistency\. Do not create fake reviews or use a false business address\. ## 8\. BUSINESS ACCESS FOR TWO PARTNERS There are TWO business partners\. Both partners must have access to all business platforms\. - Full administrator/owner access wherever supported\. - Both partners must be able to manage social media accounts\. - Both partners must be able to edit and manage the website\. - Both partners must have access to business files and designs\. - Both partners must be able to manage enquiries and business content\. Accounts must be created using our business email addresses or transferred to our ownership\. The freelancer must not retain ownership or permanent control of our accounts\. ## 9\. COMPLETE FINAL HANDOVER Before completing the project, provide: - All social media account links\. - Website link and administrator access\. - Access for both business partners\. - Final logo files and original source files\. - All social media designs and editable files\. - All videos and content files\. - Business profile and catalogue documents\. - Website management instructions\. - Account setup and handover document\. - Any relevant login details through a secure method\. We must be able to independently manage the entire business online after project completion\. ## 10\. IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS - No paid domain\. - No paid hosting\. - No paid website subscriptions\. - Use free tools and platforms wherever possible\. - No additional purchases without approval\. - All designs and content must be original or properly licensed\. - Do not use fake information or make unverified business claims\. - We will provide our business ideas, logo references and required information\. - We want a professional, clean and premium international B2B business image\.

opportunities.description: I have a Meta Ads Manager account with a single campaign that shows Active and error-free, yet the budget never leaves the wallet. I’ve already followed every tip the Meta support chatbot could throw at me, but impressions and spend are still stuck at zero. For this one-time consultation I’d like you to start by digging into my audience, budget, and campaign delivery settings, then work outward. The campaign objective is set to Messages or leads, and responses should be routed to WhatsApp. Everything else—from billing to policy status—looks clean on my side, so I suspect a hidden delivery blocker or mis-configured optimization setting. I’m happy to share screens or grant temporary view access so you can audit the ad set, placements, optimization goal, learning phase status, and any throttling flags inside Business Manager. Once you spot the issue, please walk me through the fix step-by-step so I can replicate it in the future and get the campaign spending immediately.

opportunities.title: 3D Sewer Manholes for TBC -- 2
opportunities.description: Civil 3D + Trimble Business Center: 3D Sewer Manhole Models (53 Structures) I need a Civil 3D specialist to model 53 sewer manholes in 3D and compile them into one Trimble Business Center project for machine control. Quick turnaround needed. What I'll provide: - 2D site layout DWG with manhole locations and pipe runs - Control points (Texas State Plane North, NAD83, US survey feet) - Sewer plan and profile sheets with rims and inverts - Precast manhole fabrication drawings (base and cone are standard) What I need: - Build the precast base and cone once as a reusable template - Model each manhole with the chamber, all pipe connections and correct inverts - One DWG per manhole (53 total) with clear layer names - DWGs must open and stay editable in Civil 3D 2023 - One consolidated TBC project (.vce), ready for upload to Trimble Connect - A summary sheet (Excel) with structure names, coordinates, rims and inverts - Geometry must match the control points within 5 mm Requirements: - Licensed Civil 3D and Trimble Business Center (commercial, not student version) - Experience with pipe networks and TBC for machine control - Trimble Connect account to test the upload How we'll work: - Start with a test of 2 manholes, through to the .vce, before the full set - Project files shared after hiring In your proposal, please tell me: - Which Civil 3D and TBC versions/edition you have - A similar utility or machine control project you've done

opportunities.title: 16x40 Two-Bedroom House Design
opportunities.description: I have a 16 × 40-foot footprint and want a well-planned two-bedroom house that makes every square foot count. One bedroom should sit right by the entrance, while the second sits at the far end for privacy. Between them, I need a comfortable flow that fits: • two bathrooms • a practical kitchen • a welcoming living room Please develop a space-efficient layout that respects these placements and shows clear circulation. What I expect to receive is a scaled floor plan with dimensions, room labels, and door/window positions. If you can also include a simple 3D view or colored layout to illustrate proportions, that would help me visualize the design, but the core requirement is the accurate 2D plan. Feel free to propose creative storage ideas or minor layout tweaks as long as the primary room list and front-to-back bedroom arrangement remain intact.

opportunities.description: Looking for a Professional Video Creator – Supermarket Advertisement Project: Sri Venkateshwara Super Market – Promotional Advertisement Video We are looking for a creative and professional video editor/creator to produce an attractive, high-quality promotional advertisement video for our supermarket located in Nuthankal, Telangana, India. Project Requirements * Create a professional supermarket advertisement video. * Duration: 30–60 seconds. * Language: Telugu (with clear Telugu voice-over). * Include attractive animations, transitions, background music and sound effects. * Use our original supermarket logo and branding. * Showcase supermarket products, shopping experience and store interiors. * Highlight our special offers and discounts. * Create an engaging advertisement suitable for Instagram Reels, Facebook, WhatsApp and YouTube. * Include professional voice-over (male or female). Promotional Content * Sri Venkateshwara Super Market is now OPEN! * Enjoy 10% OFF on eligible products. * Attractive shopping experience and great deals. * Make the advertisement engaging and encourage customers to visit our store. What We Expect * High-quality Full HD or 4K video. * Creative storytelling and professional editing. * Telugu-speaking audience understanding. * Original and eye-catching advertisement. * Final video in vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) formats. When Submitting Your Bid Please share: 1. Your previous supermarket or retail advertisement videos. 2. Your best price for this project. 3. Estimated delivery time. 4. Whether Telugu voice-over is included. 5. Number of revisions included. We are looking for someone who can create a premium-quality advertisement that attracts customers and promotes our supermarket professionally.

opportunities.title: Windows RAM Automation in C#
opportunities.description: We are looking for a developer to build a standalone Windows application (developed in C# .NET or C++) that acts as an automated controller for a third-party graphical Win32 process. The integration must be handled via direct RAM reading (Memory Reading / ReadProcessMemory / dynamic offset scanning). Important: Solutions based on screen clickers, macro recorders, or image recognition (e.g., OpenCV) will not be considered. We require strict data analytics retrieved directly from RAM. Key Functionality: 1. Memory Reading & Navigation: The application must read a specific data structure (a 2D coordinate map of passability and objects positioned on it) from the process's address space. Based on this dynamic data, the application must calculate optimal travel routes using the A* (A-Star) algorithm, complete with anti-stuck logic. 2. Rapid Response Module (State Machine): Continuous monitoring of specific triggers in memory. If a numerical value drops below a critical threshold (e.g., <35%), the application must instantly execute an emergency action: either a forced TCP Disconnect (severing the process's network connection) or killing the process with zero delay. 3. Input Emulation: Based on the calculated coordinates, the program must emulate mouse and keyboard actions (via WinAPI / SendInput / driver-level emulation) with configurable timing randomization (Humanizer logic) to mimic natural user behavior. 4. Cyclic Data & Inventory Management: When a specific buffer or inventory fills up, the program must execute a routine to return to the starting point and organize objects using Ctrl+Click emulation. Developer Requirements: • Deep understanding of WinAPI, Windows process architecture, memory management, and data structures. • Practical experience in reverse engineering and finding pointers/offsets following target software updates.

opportunities.title: Commission-Based Business Development & Lead Generation Specialist
opportunities.description: # Commission-Based Business Development & Lead Generation Specialist **White-Label GoHighLevel (GHL) Services** ### About the Opportunity We are building a business offering white-label GoHighLevel (GHL) services to small and medium-sized businesses. Our services include: - Professional website development - CRM and sales pipeline setup - Appointment booking and scheduling - Reputation management and automated review generation - AI chatbots and automated customer follow-ups - Email and SMS marketing automation - Lead capture and business automation We are looking for a motivated, resourceful individual who can identify prospective businesses, generate leads, and convert them into paying customers. ### Initial Compensation – Performance Based We are starting with an organic customer acquisition strategy. - Earn **$100 for every paying customer successfully onboarded.** - Your responsibility is to find prospective businesses, introduce our services, help generate interest, and bring customers through the onboarding process. - Once you successfully onboard your first **5 paying customers**, we will transition you to a monthly payment/retainer PLUS ongoing commissions. This is an opportunity to grow with the business rather than simply work on a one-time commission basis. ### Initial Marketing Strategy – Organic Lead Generation Initially, we want to focus on cost-effective, organic methods to acquire customers without spending money on advertising. You will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies such as: - **Google Maps & Google Scraping:** Identify local businesses that need better websites, booking systems, CRM solutions, or automated follow-ups. - **LinkedIn:** Find business owners, decision-makers, and potential customers through organic outreach and networking. - **Social Media:** Create and publish posts on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms. - **Lead Generation Automation:** Use automation tools to identify prospects, organize leads, and manage follow-up campaigns. - **Cold Outreach:** Contact businesses through personalized emails, messages, and phone calls. - **Business Research:** Identify companies with outdated websites, poor online reviews, no booking systems, or limited customer follow-up. We want someone who can think creatively and consistently find new ways to generate customers organically. ### Growth Strategy – After 5 Paying Customers Once we reach our first 5 paying customers, we plan to expand our marketing efforts and invest in additional customer acquisition channels. These may include: - Meta advertising (Facebook and Instagram Ads) - Google Ads - Paid lead-generation platforms - Advanced marketing automation tools - SMS and email marketing campaigns - Other paid platforms to accelerate customer acquisition. At that stage, you will transition to a **monthly retainer plus commission**, with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as we grow. ### Who We Are Looking For - Experience with GoHighLevel is a strong advantage. - Experience in lead generation, sales, or digital marketing. - Familiarity with Google Maps scraping and prospecting tools. - Knowledge of LinkedIn and social media marketing. - Ability to use AI tools and automation to increase productivity. - Self-motivated, organized, and results-oriented. - Someone entrepreneurial who wants to help build and grow a business. ### How to Apply Please provide: 1. A brief description of your experience with GoHighLevel, lead generation, or digital marketing. 2. Examples of how you would find your first 20 prospective customers organically. 3. If you have GHL experience, explain how you would use it to help acquire and onboard customers. **Our Goal:** Start lean, acquire our first 5 paying customers organically, build a repeatable sales process, and then scale using paid advertising and additional marketing resources. We are looking for someone interested in growing with us long-term.

La persona seleccionada trabajará con planos, hojas de cálculo, fichas técnicas y documentación de proyectos, apoyando al equipo de ingeniería. Requisitos - Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de energía solar fotovoltaica. - Manejo de AutoCAD. - Capacidad para interpretar planos eléctricos y documentación técnica. - Manejo de Excel y herramientas ofimáticas. - Organización, autonomía y atención al detalle. - Capacidad para seguir procedimientos técnicos y trabajar en equipo. Se valorará - Formación en ingeniería eléctrica, energías renovables o delineación técnica. - Experiencia en elaboración de documentación As-Built. - Conocimientos de instalaciones eléctricas de baja y media tensión. - Experiencia en control de calidad y revisión documental. Perfil buscado Buscamos una persona resolutiva, organizada y con criterio técnico, capaz de trabajar con autonomía, detectar inconsistencias y contribuir a la calidad de los entregables de ingeniería.

opportunities.title: Bangun Sistem Pemesanan Pelanggan
opportunities.description: Saya ingin membangun sebuah sistem kustom yang memungkinkan pelanggan melakukan pemesanan atau mengajukan permintaan layanan secara online. Fokus utama proyek ini adalah: • Antarmuka pelanggan yang intuitif sehingga mereka dapat memilih layanan, mengisi detail, dan mengirimkan permintaan dalam beberapa langkah sederhana. • Dasbor admin untuk memantau, menyetujui, atau menjadwalkan permintaan, lengkap dengan pencarian dan filter cepat. • Notifikasi otomatis (email / WhatsApp) saat permintaan baru dibuat atau statusnya berubah. Kinerja, keamanan, dan kemudahan pemeliharaan menjadi prioritas. Saya terbuka dengan pilihan teknologi—Laravel, Node.js, atau stack serupa—selama solusi akhir responsif dan dapat diskalakan. Integrasi modul tambahan seperti akun login pelanggan atau pembayaran daring mungkin kami kembangkan di fase berikutnya, jadi struktur kode perlu modular. Sertakan dalam penawaran: • Rencana singkat arsitektur dan tools utama yang akan digunakan. • Perkiraan waktu penyelesaian tahap pengembangan inti (fitur pemesanan + dasbor admin). • Contoh proyek sejenis yang pernah Anda kerjakan. Saya menantikan solusi end-to-end yang siap dipasang di server kami, lengkap dengan dokumentasi singkat penggunaan dan panduan deploy.

opportunities.title: Setter de Ventas Español Nativo
opportunities.description: Dispongo de un CRM con datos verificados (correos electrónicos y teléfonos) de empresas que encajan con nuestros servicios. Necesito que cada mes se generen reuniones calificadas a partir de esa base, utilizando exclusivamente correos electrónicos como canal de contacto inicial. Qué espero de tu parte •llamadas en frío en Españolpara la captación. • Redacción y envío de secuencias de e-mails persuasivos en perfecto español nativo. • Seguimiento ordenado de aperturas, respuestas y confirmaciones dentro del mismo CRM. • Agendado de las citas en mi calendario, incluyendo nombre de la empresa, cargo del contacto y enlace de reunión. • Informe mensual con métricas clave: número de correos enviados, tasas de apertura, respuestas y reuniones efectivamente agendadas. Recursos que recibirás • Acceso completo al CRM con los leads precargados. • Calendario compartido. • Lineamientos de tono de marca y objetivos de reunión. Este proyecto no tiene una fecha de cierre estricta; busco una colaboración continua siempre que se cumpla el objetivo mensual de citas. Si tienes experiencia previa como SDR o setter de ventas orientado a pymes y dominas herramientas de email automation/CRM, me encantará conocer tu propuesta y resultados previos.

opportunities.title: Setter Instagram para Fitness Online
opportunities.description: Busco SETTER para cuenta de Instagram de fitness (@serefittt, ~45k seguidores) Soy entrenador personal y llevo una asesoría online (Team Sere) con unos 50 clientes. Busco un/a setter que gestione los mensajes directos de Instagram y convierta a los interesados en llamadas agendadas conmigo. Qué harás: - Responder y abrir conversaciones por DM con seguidores e interesados (respuestas a stories, reels y formulario). - Cualificar a cada lead: objetivo, situación actual, compromiso y capacidad de inversión. - Agendar videollamadas de 15-20 minutos conmigo con los leads cualificados. - Hacer seguimiento a quienes no responden o no se presentan. - Llevar un registro sencillo de leads, llamadas agendadas y resultados. Requisitos: - Español nativo o nivel muy alto, escrito natural y cercano (nada de mensajes de robot). - Experiencia como setter o en ventas por DM, mejor si es en fitness o coaching online. - Disponibilidad diaria para responder rápido, incluidas algunas horas de tarde. - Seriedad y confidencialidad con los datos de los seguidores. opportunities.title: Automate Website Click Sequences
opportunities.description: I need a small, reliable automation tool that will log in to a specific website, move through a set of pages, and carry out the same click-based workflow over and over without my help. The flow is always the same: • Sign in with the credentials I will supply. • Navigate to the target section. • On each cycle pick the next available date shown on the calendar/widget, click it, submit, then advance to the following page. • Repeat the sequence continuously until we get the confirmation Choosing the date is the only dynamic step—the script must detect whatever the site labels as the “next available” option and act on it automatically. Everything else (buttons, links, or menu items) is static. I am open to your preferred stack—Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer, or a lightweight headless browser—so long as it runs on Windows and is straightforward for me to launch. Final hand-off should include: 1. Executable or script with clear setup instructions. 2. Read-me explaining how to adjust credentials or site URLs if they change. 3. Brief note on dependencies and how to reinstall them. Once delivered, I will test the script across several cycles; if it logs in correctly, selects the proper next date each time, submits, and advances without error, the job is complete.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40797290, publicado hace 13 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 150,000 - 250,000.

opportunities.title: High-Accuracy Quotex Trading Bot
opportunities.description: I need a custom bot for the Quotex platform that can generate buy-and-sell signals with at least 90 % historical accuracy, then either show those signals or execute them automatically—whichever mode I select at the time. Core behaviour • Signal engine: the algorithm must analyse both regular and OTC currency pairs and flag high-probability entries. • Dual mode switch: one click lets me stay in “signals only”, another puts the bot into fully automated trading right after each signal. • User-defined controls: before every session I must be able to set my trade amount, the exact expiry time, and a hard daily loss limit; once these limits are hit the bot stops opening new positions. Technical expectations The solution should connect reliably to Quotex (API, WebSocket, or secure headless browser—whichever is most stable), run 24/7 on a VPS, log every action, and send real-time notifications (Telegram or email are fine). Source code needs to be clean, well commented, and handed over at project close so I can audit or extend it later. Acceptance criteria 1. Back-test or forward-test report demonstrating ≥90 % signal accuracy across a representative data sample. 2. Seamless toggle between “signals only” and “auto trade”, with no missed entries in automated mode. 3. Dashboard or config file where I adjust trade amount, expiry time, and daily loss limit before trading starts. If you have proven experience with Quotex, binary options automation, or high-accuracy signal generation, let me know how you plan to hit the 90 % target and which tech stack (Python, Node, etc.) you prefer.

opportunities.title: Automatización n8n, IA y CRM para Agencia
opportunities.description: En Agencia WOW estamos buscando un perfil senior hispanohablante especializado en automatización con n8n, IA conversacional y desarrollo no-code/low-code con un fuerte perfil de agencia. Necesitamos un profesional con el know-how operativo de una agencia digital para desarrollar, estructurar y optimizar nuestros propios sistemas internos (que servirán como nuestro principal caso de éxito) y que, posteriormente, se quede integrado en nuestro equipo como colaborador técnico de referencia para los proyectos de nuestros clientes. Fase 1: Alcance del Desarrollo Inicial: - Agente de Voz de Recepción (Entrante): Configuración y optimización de un agente de voz (Vapi o Retell AI conectado a LLMs) que atienda llamadas de la S.L., resuelva dudas frecuentes, cualifique y derive. Es fundamental minimizar y optimizar los costes por llamada, necesitamos que en esta toma de contacto agende automáticamente en Cal.com / Calendly. - Central de Mensajería Multi-canal (Estilo ManyChat propio): Implementación sobre infraestructura propia (VPS) utilizando herramientas open-source como Typebot o Chatwoot integradas con n8n. - Orquestación y CRM: Conexión de todo el flujo anterior a través de n8n (alojado en nuestro VPS) para volcar y actualizar fichas de contactos y oportunidades en el CRM. Fase 2: Colaboración Continua y Comercial (Post-Lanzamiento) Una vez validado el sistema interno, la relación continuará a largo plazo. Requerimos que el candidato aporte: - Su catálogo de servicios técnicos con precios cerrados por implementación. - Su tarifa por hora como colaborador externo para mantenimientos o desarrollos a medida. - Tiempos de respuesta (SLA) y disponibilidad para ejecutar los trabajos. - Capacidad y soltura para reunirse de forma telemática con clientes finales y vender/explicar técnicamente las soluciones haciendo las veces de nuestro equipo de ingeniería. Requisitos Indispensables: - Habla hispana nativa (preferiblemente ubicado en España o países con franja horaria compatible). - Experiencia demostrable en n8n, Vapi/Retell AI, Typebot, APIs/GraphQL y TwentyCRM o CRMs custom. - Experiencia previa trabajando en agencias de marketing digital o automatización (conocimiento de embudos de ventas y campañas de Meta Ads). - Enfoque a optimización de costes y arquitecturas escalables. Para aplicar: Por favor, comparte enlaces a proyectos reales donde hayas implementado agentes de voz combinados con n8n y CRMs, junto con tu propuesta económica inicial para la Fase 1.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Aplicación Web Multiempresa para Gestión de Remunerac...
opportunities.description: Se busca un equipo o desarrollador para crear una aplicación web robusta y segura destinada a una firma jurídica especializada en asesoría de remuneración flexible para empleados. La plataforma debe ser multiempresa, permitiendo el ingreso con roles diferenciados y asegurando el aislamiento de datos entre cada firma. Los módulos clave incluyen: - Ingreso multiempresa con gestión de roles y datos aislados. - Carga masiva de datos de empleados y remuneración desde archivos Excel/CSV, con validaciones integradas para asegurar la integridad de la información. - Configuración de parámetros por empresa, incluyendo proporción de remuneración, menú de beneficios, elegibilidad y reglas vigentes. - Un simulador individual que compare el esquema de remuneración actual con el propuesto, asigne cupos de beneficios y muestre detalles como salario, aportes, retención, ingreso neto, efectivo disponible, beneficios restringidos y ahorros mensuales/anuales. - Generación de reportes individuales en formato PDF/Excel y reportes consolidados. - Un sistema de auditoría completo para registrar cargas, modificaciones, simulaciones y aprobaciones. La firma proporcionará presentaciones y capturas de un simulador anterior como referencia funcional. Es fundamental que las reglas jurídicas y fórmulas, definidas por la firma, sean configurables, versionables y diferenciadas para salario ordinario e integral. Se prefiere el uso de tecnologías como React/TypeScript para el frontend, ASP.NET Core (.net 10 lts) para el backend y postgresql como base de datos, aunque se considerarán alternativas bien justificadas. Dada la naturaleza de los datos (personales y salariales), la seguridad es primordial, requiriendo aislamiento por empresa, permisos por rol, cifrado de datos, auditoría exhaustiva y respaldos regulares. El alojamiento de la aplicación debe ofrecer una tarifa mensual fija, sin cobros automáticos basados en el número de usuarios, simulaciones o consultas, ni autoescalado. Se deberá especificar la capacidad, límites, costo de respaldos y posibles cargos adicionales. La propiedad del código fuente, el acceso al repositorio, las cuentas de despliegue y toda la documentación técnica deben ser transferidos a la firma al finalizar el proyecto. Se solicita incluir en la propuesta la experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiempresa, un cronograma detallado y una cotización separada por fases de desarrollo, costos de alojamiento y mantenimiento. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Videos Financieros Narrativos YouTube
opportunities.description: Necesito producir una serie de videos que capten la atención desde los primeros segundos y mantengan una alta retención para así poder monetizar mi canal. La temática es enseñar economía y finanzas personales a adultos que desean mejorar su situación, pero todo debe ir contado en forma de historias: anécdotas cotidianas, casos reales y ejemplos que emocionen antes de explicar el concepto económico de fondo. Cada pieza debe sentirse profesional y dinámica, con ritmo audiovisual atractivo, subtítulos claros y llamadas a la acción discretas que motiven al espectador a ver otro episodio, suscribirse y compartir. Valoraría el uso de motion graphics sencillos, efectos de sonido ligeros y música de fondo libre de derechos que no opaque la narración. opportunities.title: Need to attend a conference in Rome on my behalf
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a freelancer to attend a conference in Rome, Italy, on my behalf. The primary goal of this assignment is to showcase our product. This is a lead generation strategy to bring for future clients. Your responsibilities will include showing the banner to the mass of people present at the event. Who is interested in our product? Just ask to scan the Telegram/WhatsApp/Teams QR given on the banner. Our backend team will be available on those handles, and they will take them forward. The main aim is establishing connections that could lead to future business opportunities. We are looking for a local freelancer in Rome, Italy. who can attend a conference on behalf of our company. You have to take snaps during the event. The conference will be for 2 days; just enjoy the time and have fun. The conference is on 3rd & 4th November 2026. At the end we want the snap you have taken, and a report on the event should be sent by email. The format of the report will be given by us. A person should be frank enough and have good communication. Key tasks include: - Actively networking with potential clients - Distributing prepared networking materials (business cards and brochures) Ideal skills for this job include: - Strong communication and interpersonal skills - Experience in business networking - Ability to represent a company professionally If you have potential and you are interested, please send me a message so that we can discuss... We can also associate for post-event activity also; if performance is great, we can appoint you as country manager further.
